import os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected="da7e46f5e07922eb63b7b48e71319588bd28d3d5"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check,env=env)

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch=run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
if head!=expected or branch!="feat/self-dogfood-20261007":
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected state head={head} branch={branch}")

p=wt/"tests/test_browser_hardening.py"
text=p.read_text()

old='''    def test_successful_rollover_records_owned_successor_before_binding(self):
        record = self.bind()
        new = cdp.Target("new", browser.CHATGPT_URL, "", "ws://127.0.0.1/new")
'''
new='''    def test_successful_rollover_records_owned_successor_before_binding(self):
        record = self.bind()
        browser._record_owned_chat(self.repo, self.target.url, created_reason="bootstrap")
        new = cdp.Target("new", browser.CHATGPT_URL, "", "ws://127.0.0.1/new")
'''
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("success fixture anchor missing")
text=text.replace(old,new,1)

old='''        registry = browser._read_json(browser._owned_chat_registry_path(self.repo))
        self.assertEqual(registry["chats"][0]["chat_id"], "new")
        self.assertEqual(registry["chats"][0]["handoff_token"], "fixedtoken")
'''
new='''        registry = browser._read_json(browser._owned_chat_registry_path(self.repo))
        successor = next(row for row in registry["chats"] if row["chat_id"] == "new")
        self.assertEqual(successor["handoff_token"], "fixedtoken")
'''
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("success registry assertion anchor missing")
text=text.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(text)

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(wt/"src")

compile_proc=run(
    ["python3","-m","py_compile","src/do_again/browser/runtime.py","tests/test_browser_hardening.py"],
    check=False,env=env
)
print("compile_rc="+str(compile_proc.returncode))
print(compile_proc.stderr)
if compile_proc.returncode!=0:
    raise SystemExit(compile_proc.returncode)

focused=run(
    ["python3","-m","unittest","tests.test_browser_hardening","tests.test_browser"],
    check=False,env=env
)
print("=== focused stdout ===")
print(focused.stdout)
print("=== focused stderr ===")
print(focused.stderr)
print("focused_rc="+str(focused.returncode))
if focused.returncode!=0:
    raise SystemExit(focused.returncode)

run(["git","add","src/do_again/browser/runtime.py","tests/test_browser_hardening.py"])
commit=run(["git","commit","-m","Harden transactional chat rollover and archival"],check=False)
print("=== commit stdout ===")
print(commit.stdout)
print("=== commit stderr ===")
print(commit.stderr)
if commit.returncode!=0:
    raise SystemExit(commit.returncode)
print("new_head="+run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after="+repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
